# Implementation Plan: Kpopdle Card Game

**Branch**: `001-idol-card-game` | **Date**: 2026-06-14 | **Spec**: [spec.md](spec.md)

**Input**: Feature specification from `specs/001-idol-card-game/spec.md`

**Note**: This plan was generated by `/speckit-plan`. See `.specify/templates/plan-template.md` for the execution workflow.

## Summary

Add a Kpop idol card collecting and daily competition game to the existing Kpopdle platform. Players collect cards representing real idols (3 rarities, stats derived from real-world data), build lineups around weekly songs, and auto-compete in daily music show events. Scores are computed from card stats, configurable show multipliers, a size bonus, and a ~±10% random factor. Results feed a global leaderboard; rewards are pull currency distributed by rank percentile. The gacha system uses banners (time-limited or permanent) with mixed rarity pools, player-chosen rate-up idols, banner-specific free pull grants, and a pity guarantee. All tuning parameters live in a config table — no code changes required to adjust rates or multipliers.

The feature is built on top of the existing Node.js/Express + PostgreSQL backend and React 19 frontend. Key additions: JWT authentication, 14 new PostgreSQL tables (plus 2 column extensions on existing tables), a REST API under `/api/card-game/`, a `node-cron` scheduler for daily show resolution, and new frontend pages for the card game. Girl Group launches first; Boy Group schema is present but not exposed in UI.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: JavaScript — Node.js 18+ (backend), React 19 (frontend)

**Primary Dependencies**:
- Backend (existing): Express 5, pg, cors, dotenv
- Backend (new): jsonwebtoken, bcrypt, node-cron
- Frontend (existing): React 19, React Router v7, Vite 8

**Storage**: PostgreSQL (already in use; schema extensions detailed in [data-model.md](data-model.md))

**Testing**: No test framework in place; validation via [quickstart.md](quickstart.md) scenarios

**Target Platform**: Web application — browser frontend + Node.js server, single-server deployment

**Project Type**: Full-stack web application

**Performance Goals**:
- Show results visible within 5 minutes of daily deadline
- Daily free pack claim under 30 seconds
- Leaderboard reads for up to ~10,000 entries without degradation

**Constraints**:
- All gacha rates, pity thresholds, multiplier values, and reward amounts must be tunable via DB without code changes
- No real-money transactions anywhere in scope
- GG-only UI at launch; BG schema present but not surfaced
- Show deadline is a global timestamp; all players operate under it regardless of timezone

**Scale/Scope**: Small-to-medium player base at launch; single-server deployment; ~hundreds of card definitions at launch, growing with each comeback/milestone release

**Structure Decision**: Extended the existing backend with `middleware/`, `routes/`, and `services/` subdirectories to isolate card game logic from existing guessing game routes in `server.js`. Frontend card game code lives under `src/card-game/` as a self-contained subtree, avoiding coupling with the existing guessing game components.

## Implementation Conflicts

The following already-implemented code conflicts with the design changes from 2026-06-21 and must be rewritten before those tasks are closed.

### Schema (`backend/migrate-card-game.js`)
- `banners.rarity` column must be dropped — banners no longer have a single rarity.
- `banners.ends_at` must become nullable — permanent banners (daily banner) have no end date.
- `users.last_free_pack_claimed_gg` / `_bg` must be renamed to `last_daily_pull_gg` / `_bg`.
- New table `banner_free_pulls (banner_id, user_id, free_pulls_remaining, claimed_at)` must be added.

### Gacha service (`backend/services/gachaService.js`)
- `claimFreePack()` must be replaced: the old "give N global Rare cards" logic becomes a daily banner pull that draws from the daily banner's own card pool and checks `users.last_daily_pull_gg/bg`.
- `pull()` rarity-to-pool routing (line 158: `if (rarity === banner.rarity)`) must change: for any rolled rarity, filter `banner_cards` to that rarity and draw from the result; fall back to the global active pool only if no banner cards exist for that rarity.
- `pull()` currency deduction must use costs from `gacha_config` (`single_pull_cost`, `multi_pull_cost`, `multi_pull_count`) rather than deducting `count` directly.
- Free pull check must run before currency deduction: decrement `banner_free_pulls.free_pulls_remaining` first (up to 10 per interaction); deduct currency only when free pulls are 0.

### Collection service (`backend/services/collectionService.js`)
- Starter collection logic must be replaced: instead of inserting all active Rare cards, route `gacha_config.starter_pull_count` pulls (default 30) through the pull reveal flow, returning cards one-by-one so the frontend can animate reveals.

### Routes (`backend/routes/cardGame.js`)
- `GET /banners`: `getActiveBanners` DB query must treat NULL `ends_at` as no expiry (currently filters `ends_at > NOW()`).
- `POST /banners/:bannerId/pull`: Must check and decrement `banner_free_pulls` before touching currency; must apply configurable per-pull cost from `gacha_config`.
- Free pack route (`POST /card-game/free-pack` or equivalent): Must be replaced by a daily banner pull endpoint using the daily banner's card pool and `last_daily_pull_gg/bg` to gate the once-per-day claim.

### DB queries (`backend/db.js`)
- `getBannerWithMembers`: Must return `banner_cards` members without rarity-gating (banner no longer has a single `rarity` field); callers filter by rarity after roll.
- `getActiveBanners`: Must treat NULL `ends_at` as no expiry (e.g. `(ends_at IS NULL OR ends_at > NOW())`).

### Config seed (`backend/seed-gacha-config.js`)
- New keys required: `single_pull_cost` (1), `multi_pull_cost` (9), `multi_pull_count` (10), `starter_pull_count` (30), `daily_banner_sr_rate` (small SR rate for the daily banner, e.g. 0.03).
